input: Map out a realistic clutter-free capsule wardrobe

gold.taskTitle: Build a Realistic Clutter-Free Capsule Wardrobe
gold.taskDescription: Map out a practical, clutter-free capsule wardrobe tailored to the user's lifestyle, body, and preferences.

questions.title: What is your primary daily lifestyle or occupation?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user works in an office, from home, outdoors, or in a creative field shapes the entire wardrobe foundation.

questions.title: How many total pieces are you aiming for?
questions.description: Knowing the target number helps define the scope and boundaries of the capsule wardrobe plan.

questions.title: Which climate or season are you building this wardrobe for?
questions.description: Temperature, humidity, and seasonal range determine fabric choices, layering needs, and item types.

questions.title: Do you have a defined color palette in mind?
questions.description: A cohesive color scheme is central to a capsule wardrobe so that all pieces mix and match easily.

questions.title: What is your current approach to shopping — budget or investment pieces?
questions.description: Knowing the budget mindset helps recommend whether to focus on affordable basics or quality staples built to last.

questions.title: Are there specific clothing categories you want excluded?
questions.description: Some users want no formal wear, no athleisure, or no specific item types, which directly shapes what gets included.

questions.title: Are you starting from scratch or editing an existing wardrobe?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user needs to build from zero or declutter and refine what they already own changes the entire action plan.
